review_response_tasks.stem: May wants to make a small present for her grandfather with her own hands. She is free on Saturday afternoon and would like to carry the finished object home.
options: A

River Path Morning: On Sunday mornings, a guide takes students along the riverside path to watch water birds and photograph plants. The walk stays outdoors and includes quiet stops for observation. It is not a sports competition or an indoor history talk.
B

Makers' Gift Table: On Saturday afternoons, students use clean old paper and small wooden pieces to make picture frames. A tutor shows simple techniques, and everyone can take their finished frame home as a gift. No long outdoor walk is included.
C

Court Together: On Sunday afternoons, students learn basic volleyball skills and play short team games. Groups change during the session so that participants meet different teammates. Beginners are welcome, but the main activity is exercise rather than watching a film.
D

Voices of the Town: On Sunday afternoons, older residents bring photographs of local streets and explain how daily life used to be different. Students can ask questions and compare the pictures with a map. This is an indoor discussion, not a long outdoor tour.
E

F
